plan.title: Direct RFQ Split Award to PO

steps.note: Open the direct single-stage event creation screen.
Enable quantity splitting across vendors.
Enable event creation through the eRFX/sourcing product flow.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Change the default event type to RFQ and configure whole-lot mode before the later split allocation.

args.title: SRC-E2E-018 Direct Single Stage RFQ Split Award

steps.note: Provide the mandatory event title.
Apply the RFQ pricing template so the sourcing sheet is available.
Add the specified product and requested quantity.
Verify the requested product was placed in the sheet.
Verify the requested quantity.
Verify the product's automatically filled variant.
Select the required delivery location.
Verify the selected delivery location.
Complete any remaining required pricing-sheet fields.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Invite two QA vendors for the two independent bids.
Publish the configured RFQ.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Submit Vendor A's quote at 100.
Confirm the first vendor bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's quote at 90 from the second vendor session.
Confirm the second vendor bid was accepted.
Close the bidding window so awarding is available.
Open the buyer's comparison grid after both bids are in.
Verify both real vendor columns are present.
Verify the first vendor's line and total arithmetic.
Verify the second vendor's line and total arithmetic.
Enter the awarding screen for the closed event.
Allocate six units to Vendor B at its quoted price.
Allocate the remaining four units to Vendor A at its quoted price.
Verify the split allocation and expected proposal total of 6×90 plus 4×100.
Create and submit the split award proposal from the awarding screen.
Confirm the award proposal was created and submitted.
Approve the submitted award as the buyer-side approver.
Complete the approved award flow and create the purchase orders.
Verify the created purchase orders contain two awarded line entries in total.
Return to the events list to verify the completed event is in history.
Open the History tab.
Verify this plan's event appears in event history.
Reopen the plan's event from the history flow.
Verify Recreate Order remains available for this direct, non-PR event.
